requirements.next: Identify cash components, restrictions, legal ownership, currencies and gross settlement origins.

requirements.unavailable_state: Aggregate balances do not identify claim IDs, counterparties, allocations, maturities, gross additions or settlement events.

requirements.next: Represent lot or cohort alternatives and their measurement premises before applying an inventory method.

requirements.unavailable_state: Net PPE does not identify gross cohorts, accumulated depreciation, lives, service dates, retirements or impairment state.
unsupported_scope: straight_line_full_year cannot infer missing cohort state or fiscal service fractions.
requirements.next: Specify dated cohort memory, cost/accumulation constraints and explicit supported depreciation conventions.

requirements.unavailable_state: Term-debt captions omit instrument terms, currency, rate resets, fees, noncash movements and gross financing history; a reported dash is not zero.
unsupported_scope: One annual coupon and fixed/floating principal model cannot represent the whole disclosed instrument set.
requirements.next: Acquire instrument identity and terms; separate term-debt caption arithmetic from total financing obligations.

requirements.unavailable_state: Available borrowing, eligibility, reserved capacity, rates, fees and financing decisions are not supplied by the displayed balances.
unsupported_scope: ACT365_calendar, zero opening facility draw and zero fees are finite target assumptions.
requirements.next: Specify dated facilities, constraints and explicit funding behavior; do not manufacture balancing finance.

requirements.unavailable_state: Jurisdictional tax bases, deductible timing, reversal schedules, recognition findings and settlements remain missing.
unsupported_scope: immediate_deductible is a diagnostic model choice, not an admitted Apple tax rule.
requirements.next: Bind tax jurisdiction, measurement method and factual/review findings independently of source captions.

requirements.unavailable_state: Actual dated events and future contract or behavioral assumptions are distinct and neither is identified by aggregate period totals.
requirements.next: Supply traceable actual-event alternatives or explicit scenario assumptions; retain unknown behavior rather than fitting arbitrary events.

requirements.unavailable_state: Return rights, expected refunds, recovery costs, component allocations and recovered-lot history are unavailable.
unsupported_scope: The operations profile has no shared return module.
requirements.next: Specify externally evidenced return components and their relationship to the common book and claim state.

requirements.unavailable_state: Complete report mappings, noncash origins, OCI, instruments, leases, group state and period carry memory remain unresolved.
unsupported_scope: Fixed accounts and simple report mappings exclude parts of the reported consolidated company.
requirements.next: Use declared capability requirements and preserve every unsupported component; extend reports only with checked state/mapping semantics.
